markout_decomposed.label: EXPLORATORY: decomposed markouts (captured C, adverse D, M = C + D, fee, net) per fill and horizon, bps of the mid at the fill, positive = good for us; mid at the fill = the mid before the event that caused it

coverage.label: DATA_LIMITATION: the span after one venue's data ends is excluded from the comparison and from the suspended seconds; it is not a suspension

consume_liquidity_on_own_taker_fills.status: DELIBERATE_MODEL_CHOICE (owner 12 Nov): an own hedge or unwind fill removes the walked quantity from the book it walked; the public view book is not changed by it (every level on both venues, tested)

mark_source.label: the margin check marks a position with the venue's exchange mark when the recorded derivatives stream has one (age at most mark_max_age, 5 s ASSUMED), else with the last good mark or valid book mid (kept for up to 5 s; after that the price is missing and new risk is paused, not the kill switch); MARK_FROM_MID is the replay's labelled fallback for a venue with no exchange mark (replay only; funding is not settled from it)

manifest.sequence_gap_counter_of_the_core_book: NOT REPORTED: synthetic sequence, gaps NOT_MEASURED

entry_gates.book_age_rule: core, 500 ms, age from the last message of any kind (owner 8 Nov Q-G1)
entry_gates.dead_feed_5s: not a blocking gate; the resubscribe trigger only (Q-G2)
entry_gates.circuit_breaker: in the core (CircuitBreaker + pre-send risk gate in TradingSession, Track A item 1, off by default); ON: the profile's breaker block (profile_safety); old-path trips are in the parity report

sequence_gaps.reason: the files carry no update ids; the sequence is constructed contiguous by the converter, so a gap can never show and zero would mean nothing

feed.trade_ids: TRADE_ID_CONSTRUCTED where the record has no id
feed.resync_snapshots: SIMULATED: the data's own state at the resync time, repaired of a cross; not an exchange snapshot

config_notes.silent_carry_bound: below_one_lot: residual bound 0.01 base (risk.max_residual_base and oms.residual.max_residual_base)
config_notes.book_sanity: core defaults (500 bps mid jump and spread), KEPT (owner 8 Nov, Q-G3); the backtester has no price-sanity gate; triggers are counted in the manifest
config_notes.time: core defaults except feed age = max_book_age_s and correct_host_offset true (owner 8 Nov, Q-G4); replay receive stamps are the backtester's
config_notes.quality: core defaults (preflight limits are not used by the session)
config_notes.risk.limits: notional and gross limits set far above any clip: the backtester's own limits are position and margin based
config_notes.tick_and_step: the dated grid passed by the caller (not read from the profile's venue_ticks)
config_notes.resync_delay_s: 5.0 ASSUMED (profile setting; read by the replay driver, not part of AppConfig)
config_notes.fees: PROFILE_FEES: a replay books the profile's fee_presets; no account rates are read (a live or paper session that sends real orders refuses to start unless the account's rates equal them)
config_notes.funding_window: evaluated only where the run has derivative data (next funding times); without it every evaluation counts funding_window_not_evaluable and nothing is blocked

safety_from_profile.not_set_by_the_profile: layer_route_mode and reconcile_mode have no profile key (count); risk_gate_mode is off in the session

latency_model.zero_stages_label: ASSUMED_ZERO (owner 8 Nov: realistic values come later as a new profile version, once measured)

rows.tier: bybit_perp_vip5: linear VIP 5 (owner-confirmed tier), public schedule as given by the owner 7 Nov 2026, account SOLUSDT rates not read

binance_perp_vip9: USD-M VIP 9 (owner-confirmed tier), public schedule as given by the owner 7 Nov 2026, account SOLUSDT rates not read; with BNB the taker is 1.53 (recorded, not built: a BNB fee needs a BNB price)

hedge_move_calibration.method: PROBE: one 1 SOL Bybit bid per 15 s slot at the strategy's quote depth (qv2_probe.py, v1.1 fill rules, 00:00-02:00 UTC slice of each day); bid = the Binance mid move (bps) from each simulated probe fill to fill + 45 ms, mean over all fills. The 45 ms is an ASSUMED hedge arrival delay (the singapore preset gives about 31-52 ms for a hedge), NOT measured on mainnet. The probe is bid-only: the ask value is the market-data value, carried over unchanged and unused while maker_passive_side is bid

differences_from_backtester_loop: timing is shared (profile timing block through Timelines; venue-truth books built by this driver): the old text 'no timing timelines or venue-truth books' is no longer true (corrected 10 Nov)

STILL MISSING in the session runtime (Phase E): E0 ems/ layer (repricing, tactics, PASSIVE placements, risk gate, pairing, venue selector); E1 maker order lifetime as a timer (the OMS deadline fires only on an event or tick); E2 the fault presets and the conditional scenarios other than outage_on_fill (hedge-fault injection itself is built and opt-in: hedge_fault_injection=True, ghost and partial hedge included; the manifest key hedge_fault_injection lists what it refuses); E3 participation cap and size sweep; circuit breaker: in the core but not switched on in this replay; the backtester's margin step (the core margin engine replaces it)
